recommendations.title: Pricing section lacks transparency on real costs and plan limits
recommendations.detail: 5 of 7 personas failed to determine actual cost at scale from the pricing section. The skeptical-cfo cannot calculate a 50-seat total without a sales call, the enterprise-compliance-lead cannot confirm whether data-residency options affect tier pricing, and the solo-founder-5min cannot confidently start a trial without fear of surprise charges. The section appears to omit per-seat math, volume thresholds, and add-on costs entirely.
recommendations.suggestedChange: Rewrite the pricing section to display explicit per-seat pricing, a worked example (e.g., '50 seats × $X/month = $Y/month'), and a clear comparison table showing what each tier includes and excludes — eliminating any need to contact sales for basic cost estimation.

recommendations.title: Hero section uses a placeholder graphic and generic copy, signaling an unfinished product
recommendations.detail: The hero currently displays a purple circle explicitly labeled 'Product illustration' — a literal placeholder — instead of a real screenshot or interactive mockup. Surrounding copy relies on buzzword-heavy language that fails to explain what the product concretely does. The designer-visual-sceptic concluded within 30 seconds that the page looks AI-generated; the student-curious cannot determine what the product actually is.
recommendations.suggestedChange: Replace the 'Product illustration' placeholder with an actual product screenshot or a short looping screen-capture (GIF/video), and rewrite the hero headline to state a specific, outcome-oriented value proposition (e.g., 'Ship compliance reports 3× faster — without spreadsheets') that names a real user benefit.

recommendations.title: "$0 free forever*" CTA is a dark pattern that contradicts the fine print
recommendations.detail: The signup CTA prominently reads '$0 free forever*', but the asterisk resolves to '*30-day free trial, then $29/month. Credit card required at signup.' This is a direct contradiction: the product is not free forever. The junior-dev-comparer explicitly flagged this as a dark pattern and noted that CompetitorX offers an honest no-credit-card free tier, making this page appear deceptive by comparison.
recommendations.suggestedChange: Remove the '*free forever' claim entirely; replace the CTA with honest language such as 'Start your 30-day free trial — credit card required' or, preferably, introduce a genuine free tier with no credit card requirement and advertise it accurately.

recommendations.title: FAQ does not answer seat limits, billing cycles, or downgrade policies
recommendations.detail: Both the skeptical-cfo and student-curious attempted to use the FAQ to resolve specific cost and access questions — seat caps, annual vs. monthly billing, and what happens at trial end — and found no answers. The FAQ appears to contain generic questions that do not address the purchasing or access concerns of finance or evaluation-stage users.
recommendations.suggestedChange: Add at minimum four FAQ entries that explicitly cover: (1) per-seat pricing and volume discounts, (2) annual vs. monthly billing options, (3) what happens to data and access when a trial or plan expires, and (4) whether a free tier or student plan exists — with direct, jargon-free answers.

recommendations.title: No integration ecosystem visible anywhere on the page
recommendations.detail: The marketing-lead-research persona (Sara) specifically evaluated the page for HubSpot, Segment, and Marketo compatibility and found zero integration logos, no integrations feature section, and an FAQ that confirmed the absence rather than resolved it. A growth marketing lead who cannot confirm tool compatibility within one page visit will not proceed to a trial.
recommendations.suggestedChange: Add a dedicated integrations strip or section — ideally between the Features section and pricing — showing recognizable logos (HubSpot, Segment, Marketo, Salesforce, etc.) with a short descriptor per integration, and link to a full integrations catalog page for deeper evaluation.
